name: fast-jev-compaction-with-reflex
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: Reflex API key
apiKey.description: Bearer key for a reflex-serve daemon started with --api-key. Leave unset for a local, unauthenticated server, or to use REFLEX_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum reflex probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum reflex state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every reflex request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum reflex request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one reflex request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when reflex decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

model.title: Reflex model
model.description: Model name reported to the reflex-serve daemon (informational only; the daemon serves whatever it was started with).
